name: Trips - Right - 34 Power

QB.rule: Open right and hand to the tailback as he comes inside from the trips, then fake the boot.

TB.rule: Come inside off the bunch, take the handoff and hit the hole at our tackle's outside hip. Never bounce it back outside.

coaching_points: Nobody in the backfield. The tailback starts in the trips and comes inside for the ball.
The slot kicks the end out. The yards are inside that block, not back out to the bunch.
The fullback, widest, screens the corner.
